name: simplebilly/simplebilly-api
description: Simplebilly API - Bookkeeping, CRM, ERP. Multi-tenant API: a tenant is isolated and routed by subdomain (or a configured custom domain) under the base domain.  ## Rate limiting All endpoints are rate-limited per client IP: **100 requests per minute** on API routes and **5 requests per minute** on authentication routes. Exceeding a limit returns `429 Too Many Requests`; the window resets after 60 seconds.
